dataset_checksums.details: All 3 splits (train, val, test) matched SHA-256 hashes in Croissant metadata exactly. 0 NaN, infinite, or missing values.

prediction_provenance.details: Zero prediction mismatches across all 8,325 test flows when loading disk checkpoints (models_final/fp32_reference.pt, ptq_int8_traced.pt, qat_int8_deploy_traced.pt). Max prob diff = 0.00e+00.

confusion_matrix_arithmetic.details: Independent re-computation from raw prediction arrays reproduces all reported metrics (FP32 Acc 96.67%, PTQ 96.74%, QAT 97.00%) with 100% consistency across CSV, NPZ, and Markdown tables.

prediction_agreement.details: Pairwise agreement is 99.74% (FP32 vs PTQ) and 99.56% (FP32 vs QAT). Exactly 48 test flows exhibit disagreement across the 3 models (44 Non-VPN, 4 VPN).

bootstrap_uncertainty_and_tie_correction.details: 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples with mid-p tie correction (Davison & Hinkley, 1997) and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR multiple testing adjustment. All empirical p-values bounded in [0, 1].

attribution_tensor_alignment.details: KernelSHAP (746, 128) and Captum IG (50, 2, 64) raw tensors verified with active packet masking (L active features).

host_and_session_independence.details: Raw 5-tuple IP/port addresses and PCAP capture timestamps are not present in processed NPZ files. Evaluation is limited to stratified flow-level partitions; session-level grouping independence cannot be established.

causal_mechanism_of_drift.details: Substantially lower Top-5 attribution overlap on VPN flows (0.3032 vs 0.6959) is strongly confounded by sequence length and combinatorial candidate space expansion (R^2 = 0.448). Integer rounding is not proven as the sole causal driver.

gradient_explainer_surrogate_assumption.details: Deployed INT8 graphs are non-differentiable; Integrated Gradients requires differentiable FakeQuantize models with Straight-Through Estimators (STE) as continuous proxies, which smooth over discrete thresholds.

explainer_sampling_budget_sensitivity.details: KernelSHAP uses an idle zero baseline with finite sampling budget (100 perturbations/flow), which exhibits non-trivial sampling stochasticity (rho = 0.2767 +/- 0.2790) on 128 features.
